fact: The Central Bank of Eswatini deputy governor said in February 2025 that it had worked with the Commissioner for Refugees on KYC documents for refugees and asylum seekers and recommended a permit for all refugees so they are registered on the national civil registry and receive a national personal identification number.
title: The nexus between AML/CFT and financial inclusion
publisher: Bank for International Settlements (speech by Felicia Dlamini-Kunene)
